notes.title: The Survivalists is now available!
notes.notes:
Hey Prisoners!

You've escaped countless prisons... but are you up for the challenge of surviving island life?

If you haven't heard of The Survivalists before it's a procedurally generated and adventure-filled survival sandbox set in The Escapists universe. Explore, build, craft and even train monkeys with up to three friends in a desperate bid to survive. Have you got what it takes to be a Survivalist?


We'll stop monkeying around, here's our launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=k0D5z1sqx6k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Pick up your copy today:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/897450/The_Survivalists/

[h1]Welcome to the islands![/h1]

[h3]Explore[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5NSTKFL.gif[/img]

Explore a procedurally generated world of islands, full of exciting biomes, quests and more to discover! Each new character made generates a entirely new world, plus join online games to enter a friends set of unique islands!

[h3]Build[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/20qylSZ.gif[/img]

Don't just survive... thrive! Build a new home or epic base for you and friends! Bolster you defenses against a whole host of hostiles that could raid your camp and take your supplies!

[h3]Make Monkey Friends[/h3]

Shipwrecked life in The Survivalists is helped through its unique Monkey Mimic system, where players train up to 20 local primates to do a raft of tasks and help automate systems, from cooking and crafting, to collecting resources. Tasks can be chained together like a production line, so monkeys help make island life run a little smoother. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DckbXjT.gif[/img]

[h3]Craft[/h3]

Get crafty and become a master tinkerer in island contraptions. Make tools, furniture, weapons and more that will help you survive on the islands.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zEajwHA.gif[/img]

[h3]Survive[/h3]

Danger stalks the islands with bands of orcs that patrol the shores. Many more hostile creatures will happily make a meal out of you. Arm yourself and your monkey friends to defend your new home and stay safe on your adventures. Also keep a tab of your hunger as you need to stay in good health for island life!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2yeQgUu.gif[/img]

[h3]Escape?[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7y2UFIR.gif[/img]

Wait, what is that?

[h1]Have Fun![/h1]

notes.title: Manual saves, new tutorials and more added to The Escapists 2!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/4f55ce930191c3fe649e8dad77bdb5fc4848cc8a.gif[/img]
Hi everyone!

Today we’re excited to announce the [b]Inmate Induction[/b] update, adding several new features and improvements to The Escapists 2 to improve the experience for new and existing players alike. These improvements are based on feedback from all of you, collected from both the Steam forums, surveys and social media. Your feedback has always been very important to us, and we do hope these changes make the game even better for everyone!

[h1]Manual Saving[/h1]
You can now toggle manual saves, if you want more control over when exactly the game saves. With manual saves, you simply walk over to your own bed to be prompted to save your game. This should allow you to try your daring escapes without risk of losing everything! Save settings can be toggled in the Help & Options menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/407e76ee2fb25842fc086af7742e10b705566154.gif[/img]

[h1]Robinson To The Rescue[/h1]
Wondering how exactly to start your career as an escapists? We’ve added [b]Robinson[/b] to Center Perks 2.0, who’s the 2nd most knowledgeable escapist in the world – just behind [url=https://twitter.com/Escapists_Game]Jimmy Locke[/url], of course. Robinson will now appear in the game with a red exclamation mark above his head, which indicates that he has very special quests available for you. These new quests will teach you the very basics of perimeter escapes, including how to dig your way to freedom. If you’re unfamiliar with the benefits of using the prison’s payphones, Robinson will also make sure you’re in the know!

Beyond adding Robinson, we’ve also added a bunch of “signposts” in the prisons, where fellow inmates have dropped hints in various locations that could help pinpoint the best places to attempt your escapes from. Seek them out if you want some tips.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/06eefc9b7d32546e03af8026f370107d817236dd.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved Spawn Rates[/h1]
If you’ve had troubles finding the items needed for your various escapes, you’ll be pleased to know that this update increases spawn rates for key quest items considerably. These items can now spawn in multiple locations at the same time, making it a lot easier to pull off that sweet, sweet escape!

[h1]Game Mode Indicators[/h1]
We’ve improved the user interface to help make it easier to understand exactly how to play both local and online co-op the way you want to. This includes a clear description of the various online modes (Local, Private or Public), making it easier to understand exactly how to set up a game for just yourself and your friends. As a result, we’re hoping to only see Public games where the host intends for strangers to join the fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/ebc0b1d4ee1d5f7c79480fe5594212c52b779bb2.gif[/img]

[h1]Progression Changes[/h1]
We’ve changed the way new prisons unlock in The Escapists 2. Previously unlocking a new prison was tied to collected keys from unique escapes, and you used to have to complete most prisons to get access to the later content. Now you’ll instead have access to [b]ALL[/b] the prisons as soon as you’ve completed three unique escapes, which will let you fully explore the game a whole lot faster!

We’ve also added a number of additional improvements and fixes, that you can find in the patch notes below.

[b]Patch notes:[/b][list]
[*] Improved item spawn rates based on player feedback.
[*] Fixed an issue with one of the multiplayer doors on Dungeons and Duct Tape.
[*] Fixed an issue with picking up makeshift ladders after placing them down.
[*] Fixed an issue with vent shadows not appearing properly on Santa's Shakedown.
[*] Fixed an issue with placing indoor tiles over the cutlery drawer item in the Prison Editor.
[/list]
We’re continuously working to make The Escapists 2 the best it can be, and we hope these improvements make the game even better for all of you. As always, be sure to let us know what you think, and please continue reporting any issues in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/641990/discussions/1/]Report a Problem[/url] forum.

See you on the inside!

notes.notes:

This competition has now ended, thanks to everyone for entering! See the winners [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/641990/announcements/detail/1646502942071010175]here[/url]!

Hey everyone!

With thousands of player-created The Escapists 2 prisons already available on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/641990/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url], there are definitely a ton of amazing creations out there. We want to celebrate the immense creativity among our players, and what better way than by holding a Prison Design Contest!

Whether you're an experienced creator or are all new to the tools of The Escapists 2 Prison Editor (Pssst, find tips [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1203440910]here[/url]), we'd love to see your creations. We're leaving it open too, meaning you can create your prison(s) any way you want. Any theme, any tile-set, any objects, anything. Just be sure you're not breaking any of [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=4045-USHJ-3810]Steam's guidelines[/url]. You can publish as many prisons as you want within the competition period, as long as you include the word "[b]Contest[/b]" in the prison name (so we can find it!). Feel free to be creative with this.

[h1]How do you win?[/h1]
We knew you'd ask and creativity is key here. You can turn your prison into a piece of art by "drawing" it using the buildings, objects, tile-sets and more. You can make a prison based on something in the real or fictional world. You can create your dream (or nightmare) prison, a resort-type prison, a water world prison or whatever else you feel like. Just keep in mind; [b]it has to be playable, and it must be possible to escape. And you can't copy someone else's creation![/b]

If you'd like further inspiration, we'd encourage you to check out some of the existing masterpieces on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/641990/workshop/]Steam Workshop[/url], or some of the custom prison videos available on YouTube.

[b]Platform[/b]: Steam
[b]Entries[/b]: As many as you like
[b]How to enter[/b]: Publish an original, custom made The Escapists 2 prison map to Steam Workshop, including ‘Contest” in the prison name (so we can find it)

[b]Prizes[/b]: £20 Steam Wallet Top-Up
[b]Winners[/b]: Two (2)

[b]Good luck, and have fun creating![/b]

notes.notes:

Gather around prisoners, we’ve got brand new attractions for you!

[h1]Big Top Breakout DLC[/h1]
We’re extremely excited to announce our brand new The Escapists 2 DLC prison; Big Top Breakout! Challenging you to escape from a travelling circus with new jobs, new customisation options, new weapons and crafting recipes, and of course new wacky ways to get yourself and your friends to freedom!

Check out the Big Top Breakout Launch Trailer right here
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kZHm729aPZ4 
The Big Top Breakout DLC features:[list]
[*] A brand-new circus themed map to escape
[*] New circus themed customisations for your inmate
[*] New jobs. Tame lions, hang carnival posters, paint faces and blow up balloon animals to purchase vital supplies you’ll need to break out
[*] New items and craftable recipes
[*] New achievements and trophies to unlock[/list]
Big Top Breakout is available RIGHT NOW both separately, and as part of the Season Pass.

[h1]The Escapists 2 Prison Editor Update[/h1]
For those that have been eagerly awaiting updates to The Escapists 2 Prison Editor, I’m very happy to announce that we have a content update available for you RIGHT NOW as well. We’ve added the Rattlesnake Springs theme to the editor, adding new desert-themed tile-sets, rooms, objects, guards and soundtrack! You’ll find the new content in the tiles, rooms and objects lists, and the ability to select guard and soundtrack theme from the editor Settings. We can’t wait to see what you create and add to the more than 13,000 player-created prisons already on Steam Workshop!

For a full list of all the changes in today’s big update, find the full patch notes below.

[b]1.1.4 Patch notes:[/b][list]
[*] Editor Specific - Fixed a graphic issue when holding a premade room and hovering over the UI in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the player to lose the ability to use the "Join Game" feature provided in the Steam Overlay.
[*] Fixed various issues regarding invites within private versus sessions and lobbies.
[*] Fixed an issue altering the front end menus when spamming “continue” on the first screen.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the chat to close at the same time as the inventory would close. 
[*] Fixed an issue in various maps where the home icon wouldn’t display and escapes sometimes not trigger.
[*] Fixed an issue causing character models to disappear from the Character Select carousel after a certain amount of loads.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby plugging in a controller and pressing A during the character select screen would remove all control from the player.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pressing “Quick Mould” without the appropriate items would lock players in the inventory view.
[*] Fixed an issue causing animations to reset upon performing a Save / Load when knocked out.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby pressing Space to equip an item would sometimes consume or use it.
[*] Fixed an issue causing animations to freeze when switching item from grappling hook whilst climbing.
[*] Fixed an issue whereby the "Medic Deployed" text didn’t always fit correctly in the UI in Russian.
[*] Changed the amount of stamina standard items use.[/list]
We hope you’re as excited about these new updates as we are, and would to hear your thoughts. Rest assured that we are continuing to look for ways to improve The Escapists 2 for both creators and escapists alike, and your feedback is essential in this. notes.title: Santa’s Shakedown Available Now - For FREE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/c6893f0826ebaaeb09dc9c8a43a1ce361b9dfc66.png[/img]Just a week ago we brought you the [b]Prison Editor[/b] and today the gifts continue! Fire up [b]The Escapists 2[/b] to download our [b]FREE[/b] Christmas prison, [b]Santa’s Shakedown[/b], available right now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qp7Ebxt_4V0

With the Wicked Ward DLC we introduced a weather system in the form of thunder, lighting and rain. In Santa’s Shakedown we’re adding snowfall, which combined with the Christmas prison itself is guaranteed to get you in the holiday spirit!

[b]About Santa’s Shakedown[/b]
[i]Celebrate the festive season with this snowy free new prison that has it all: state of the art equipment, high tech security measures … and an overtly theatrical warden who has repurposed the sports hall as a theatre and is more concerned with putting on an extravagant pantomime than the wellbeing of his inmates. Look past the tacky decorations and an opportunity to escape may just present itself![/i]

Alongside the Christmas prison we've updated the game and fixed a number of issues. See below for the full patch notes.

[b]Update 1.1.3 patch notes[/b]
- Fixed a glitch causing graphic and audio issues when quitting the game as a local player with the map open.
- Fixed a glitch causing a soft lock when adding a local player to the game with the map open
- Fixed an issue causing players icons on the mini map to be visible in versus, even if they are hidden in a locker
- Fixed an issue causing the player’s character to change to a default customisation when loading an existing save with a custom character after a save upgrade
- Fixed an issue preventing the player’s character from starting with lower stats when the prison difficulty was set to Hard
- Fixed an issue causing the animations to become stuck when interacting with the map while they’re being triggered
- Fixed an issue whereby the items obtained through the Delivery Driver quest weren’t always food-related
- Fixed a graphic issue with the smoke on the Cougar Creek Railroad level
- Fixed an issue causing the UI to display the same button icon for different actions
- Now the escape time in coop is the same for the entire team
- Fixed an issue causing the countdown to stop when 2 players are tabbed out
- Fixed an issue in the Editor causing the Fitness Gym Equipment UI to layer underneath walls
- Fixed an issue in the Editor to limit the amount of guard towers available for one level
- Fixed an issue in the Editor preventing a prison to work if all the rooms were placed in the bottom right corner
- Fixed an issue in the Editor causing the Guard Cells button to remain greyed out even after removing some of them
- Fixed an issue in the Editor causing the players’ character to become invisible when studying in Social Rooms A and B
- Fixed an issue in the Editor causing the map to display some corridors incorrectly
- Various performance Improvements
- Other various bug fixes

We hope you enjoy the new content, and we look forward to bringing you even more The Escapists 2 in 2018!

notes.title: The Escapists 2 Prison Editor Available Now
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29624581/585fb5aad7960e5c3d446274b881868481dc8242.gif[/img]
Today we’re extremely pleased to announce that the long-awaited [b]Prison Editor[/b] for [b]The Escapists 2[/b] is available [b]RIGHT NOW![/b]

Using [b]Steam Workshop[/b] you can create your very own prisons, play them alone or with friends, or even share them with your fellow escapists via Steam Workshop. That of course also means that you can [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/641990/workshop/]download prisons made by other players[/url], and have a virtually infinite stream of new prisons to (try to) escape from!

[b]Check out the Prison Editor trailer![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vErcybCm1uw

Want to get started creating prisons? Check out our handy [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1203440910]Prison Editor Steam Guide[/url] on how to do just that! We have even created two extra prisons for you to play ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1185830078]Slammer Island[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1185841584]Gridline Correctional[/url]), so whether you want to create, escape, or both, we’ve got you covered!

Alongside the prison editor, today’s update also includes a number of fixes including ones to achievements, animations and performance.

[b]Patch notes: [/b]
- Made various performance improvements on PC, OSX and Linux
- Fixed an issue creating a softlock when players tab out of the game and plugs a controller in
- Fixed an issue preventing the Minimap from expanding when clicked on
- Fixed an issue preventing to unlock the "Artful Dodger" achievement when playing as a client in an Online Multiplayer session
- Fixed an issue preventing to unlock the “Good Intentions” achievement
- Fixed a graphic issue on Wicked Ward which caused display issues on the lower floors when viewed from the floor above
- Fixed an issue causing the bike fitness machine animation to play even when no one was on it
- Fixed an issue causing the prisoners’ head to pop out of kennels when trying to hide.
- Fixed an issue causing some UI elements to remain on screen when quitting during Solitary and reconnecting right after
- Fixed graphic issues occurring when collecting Cutlery while holding a Food Tray
- Fixed an issue whereby changing Play Modes when Roll Call starts blocks Inmates from entering Purple Doors
- Fixed rendering issues on some resolutions with terrain graphics
- Fixed an issue preventing clients from seeing the Lockdown lights
- … and various other fixes.

Let us know what you think of the editor, and what you would like to see from it in the future. We can’t wait for you to dive in and show off your creations!

notes.notes:

[b][i]UPDATED[/i][/b]
The first two post-launch updates for The Escapists 2 are now available to download! They address a host of things, including mouse cursor issues, multiplayer stat and progress saving, fixes to combat, Chinese localisation and UI, and general gameplay stability. Please find the full patch notes below.

[b]Patch 1 notes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where combat controls would stop working when opening any UI
- Fixed an issue where combat medics were unable to get to players in the underground of Rattlesnake Springs when digging out from cells
- Fixed an issue where player 2 in a Local multiplayer game would lose controller functionality after disconnecting their controllers while the game was minimized
- Fixed an issue where loading a save game twice during a meal routine would cause meal trays to display as white squares
- Fixed an audio issue that could occur during prolonged gameplay sessions
- Chinese - Implemented a smaller font, to fix various display issues
- Chinese - Added "Craft" and "Hold to craft" localisation to the crafting menu
- Chinese - Fixed an issue with Menu and Controller icons appearing incorrectly in the main menu
- Tons of stability tweaks

[b]Patch 2 notes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor wasn’t working in menus when a touch-screen device or Oculus Rift was detected
- Improved multiplayer stats and progression saving, allowing for all players to keep their progress when re-joining a game, provided they spawn into the same prison cell*. We will continue to work on this feature, and aim to improve it even further in the future
- Reduced the likelihood of YouTubers/Twitch streamers appearing in-game
- Further stability improvements

[i]*Each prison has four cells available for players, which are assigned when players join. Stats (Intellect, Strength and Fitness) along with money are tied to the cell that each player occupies. For example: If a player makes some progress and then leaves, the next player to join will then be given that cell and inherit the progress of the previous cell occupant. Cells are assigned to players in the same order every time, so if a group of friends are playing together and they want to carry on in the same cells as their previous session, they need to join the game in the same order as when they first played together in that prison.[/i]

As we keep updating The Escapists 2 to improve the game further, please help us by reporting any issues you see in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/641990/discussions/1/]Report a Problem[/url] forum. It's important we have detailed descriptions of issues as those allow us to identify and address these faster. To everyone taking the time to help is squash these bugs, thank you very much! Rest assured we will keep working on updates and aim to solve any issues as quickly as we can.

notes.title: The Escapists 2: sandbox survival without the survival
notes.notes:
I didn’t spend long with the first The Escapists – time off for good behaviour, perhaps – but nonetheless, playing early code for its upcoming sequel was like slipping into an old jumpsuit. Nothing like as serious as Shawshank but not as catastrophically stupid as Prison Break, this was and is, essentially, a mash-up of simulation, roleplaying and crafting in which you had to devise a DIY Get Out Of Jail Free card for your little pixel-person.

The Escapists 2 [official site] eschews traditional sequel-strategies such as flashier graphics in favour of being a reworked, expanded and ante-upped version of the first. The result is a sandbox puzzle game of impressive scope and with copious shower scenes.
